description: Development, testing, and production environments are not separated and secured. This signal indicates that different environment types share infrastructure, credentials, data, or network access without appropriate isolation controls, potentially allowing development activities to impact production systems or production data to be exposed in non-production environments.
applicability: Applicable to all computing environments including physical servers, virtual machines, cloud environments, containers, databases, network segments, and applications. Covers separation of development, testing, staging, QA, UAT, and production environments across infrastructure, platform, and software layers.

metadata.detection_notes: Commonly detected through environment inventory review, network architecture analysis, access control assessments, credential management evaluation, data flow analysis, and deployment pipeline configuration review. May also be identified through examination of environment naming, tagging, and isolation mechanisms.
